sourceVerification.officialReviewScope: Both pages retrieved independently; all-intersection graph, deleting vertical edges whose upper vertex lies inside a skywalk, and nearest-tall cuts about arbitrary s/g agree with article. Rectangle-entry/lexicographic correctness proof is independently supplied, not represented as a verbatim official proof.

originalBounds.contacts: No two skywalks share points except possibly their endpoints.

proofAndImplementationReview: Full intersection model preserves segment-union distances; nonterminal ground vertices and roof tails are dead ends.
Nearest tall predecessors/successors around strict-interior terminal columns make any remaining piece that has an internal building intersection exclude both terminals from its open horizontal span.

A bad vertical-edge prefix/suffix enters the piece rectangle through a side or top. Boundary travel is physically available and has Manhattan length no greater than the removed path, without assuming x-monotone travel.

Replacement adds no bad edge with upper height at least Y and deletes one at Y; lexicographic minimality over finite positive-weight shortest paths proves simultaneous bad-edge deletion. Same-height endpoint-only contacts ensure a piece endpoint cannot lie in another piece's interior.
Sweep starts precede queries and ends follow queries at the same column. lower_bound({Y,-1}) excludes all equal-height walks. Strictly lower projection always lies on a sufficiently tall building.
Global building/height coordinate union is essential for same-height endpoint transfers; original-walk sorting joins neighboring retained points and contracts horizontal subdivisions.
P<=6M; touches<=2P+2, vertical edges<=P, horizontal edges<=2P, total undirected edges<=3P. Reserve capacities/graph indexes/int differences remain in range.
Indexed heap keeps at most one live entry per unsettled vertex and skips already-settled neighbors. Distances and one-edge relaxations fit int64 from <=(2P+1)*1e9.

API validates all vectors/coords/heights/endpoints/terminal indices/overlap before s=g or M=0 shortcuts. N1/M0/s=g extensions are explicit. Short-circuit validation prevents out-of-bounds h lookup even with extreme invalid indices.
No input-linear recursion, all mutable state local, const input remains unchanged, byvalue original adapter included, standard allocation exceptions propagate.
O((N+M)log(N+M+1)) time and O(N+M) space hold for complete API. 132P+48 is only graph-construction major-array payload; earlier arrays/sets and caller input/copies/allocator are separately scoped.

reproduction.timingScope: Maximum case times include two API calls plus a third graph construction and edge checks. Overall run times include literal/exhaustive/random/metamorphic/API verification. Measurements do not establish a hardware-independent 4-second guarantee.

result.oracle: Unit-length raster graph BFS, no intersection compression or weighted Dijkstra

additionalIndependentProbe.construction: Rasterize each complete building and skywalk into the union of all unit-length lattice edges, including roof and nonterminal-ground dead ends, then BFS from every original ground root. No intersection graph contraction, weighted Dijkstra, tall-building selection, active sweep or indexed heap is used.
additionalIndependentProbe.exhaustiveScope: Five buildings of height2, four alternating adjacent-gap1/2 patterns, all 1156 compatible skywalk subsets per gap pattern:4624 physical instances/all25 ordered terminal pairs.
additionalIndependentProbe.randomScope: 6000 deterministic N1..12 instances, building heights1..12, x0 in0..3, adjacent gaps1..3;120 candidate skywalk attempts retained when valid. All ordered terminal pairs.
additionalIndependentProbe.metamorphicScope: For each random case, delete roof tails or extend roofs without reaching a new skywalk. Insert one new building in a gap with roof at the lowest crossing walk, adding only a one-contact vertical dead end; preserve all old-root distances and independently raster-check that invariant.
additionalIndependentProbe.checksumInterpretation: Checks counts assertions, not distinct physical inputs. It includes original API versus BFS, two height invariants, old-root API after building insertion and independent raster insertion-invariance assertions.
additionalIndependentProbe.proofOfInsertionInvariant: Fresh x lies strictly between original columns, so same-height endpoint contacts cannot occur there. Choosing the minimum covering-walk height adds exactly one geometric connection, or no connection when no walk covers the gap; its vertical building is a dead-end branch and cannot shorten old-root distances.

conclusion: No substantive mathematical, implementation, API or original-source coverage defects remain in the frozen version. The earlier memory-stage wording issue is resolved without code changes.

permanentProbe.normalization: Only article destination and removal of implicit /tmp result writes. Oracle and all assertions unchanged.
